title: v3 「코디세이로 오라」 바다판 컷 리스트 (한 컷 = 한 사람 대사)
look: Cinematic live-action Korean TV commercial, 35mm anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, golden-hour natural light, deadpan comedic tone with a perfectly serious epic sea-voyage film look, natural skin texture, 16:9, no outer space, no stars in the daytime sky, no swords, no weapons, no on-screen text, no subtitles, no captions, no logos, no watermark.

scenes.name: 파도의 신호
scenes.set: on the bow of {SHIP} on a dark rough sea under gathering storm clouds, golden light breaking through
scenes.key: Medium shot of {SABU} standing at the bow facing the camera, coat and braid whipping in the wind, huge waves behind.

cuts.shot: Slow push-in from a wide aerial view of the ship crashing through waves to a medium shot of {SABU} at the bow facing the camera, coat and braid whipping in the wind.
lines: in a grand, slow, solemn voice

scenes.name: 국문과
scenes.set: at a sunny wooden pier in front of a riverside university library, with {SHIP} docked alongside the pier
scenes.key: {SORA} on the pier on the left looking up, {SABU} leaning over the ship's rail on the right pointing the brass spyglass down at her.

cuts.shot: Low-angle medium shot of {SABU} leaning over the ship's rail.
action: she extends the brass spyglass and points it dramatically down toward the camera

cuts.shot: High-angle medium close-up of {SORA} standing alone on the pier, looking up. Nobody else is visible.
action: she blinks twice and points at herself with one finger

cuts.shot: Tight close-up of {SABU}'s face at the rail, filling the frame.
action: she stays silent and slowly raises ONE eyebrow very high, an exaggerated, clearly visible comedic eyebrow raise, the rest of her face perfectly still

scenes.name: 빈 문틀
scenes.set: at the foot of the boarding gangway on the pier, where a freestanding empty wooden door frame with no door in it stands in front of the gangway
scenes.key: {SORA} stepping through the empty door frame, {SABU} at the top of the gangway with arms crossed.

action: she walks through the empty wooden door frame, then stops and looks back at the frame, surprised

cuts.shot: Medium shot of {SABU} alone at the top of the gangway, arms crossed.
lines: flat, as if stating the obvious

scenes.name: 빈 지갑
scenes.set: at a busy harbor pier with cranes in the background, early morning, {SHIP} docked alongside
scenes.key: {DOHYUN} on the pier saluting, {SABU} on the deck of the ship above him extending her spyglass toward him.

cuts.shot: Medium shot of {SABU} on the deck rail.
action: she slowly extends the brass spyglass toward the camera with a grand gesture
lines: in a grand, slow, mysterious voice

cuts.shot: Medium shot of {DOHYUN} alone on the pier, framed from the knees up so his hands are clearly visible.
action: he snaps a crisp military salute
he pulls out a brown leather wallet and opens it wide toward the camera, showing it is completely empty
she stays silent, then gives one slow, flat nod

scenes.name: 장학금
scenes.set: at the edge of the harbor pier, with waves crashing against the pier and glittering golden spray in the morning sun
scenes.key: {DOHYUN} holding out his open wallet at the pier edge as a wave splashes glittering golden spray into it.

cuts.shot: Medium shot of {DOHYUN} alone at the edge of the pier, holding out his open wallet.
action: a wave crashes against the pier and a burst of glittering golden spray pours straight into his open wallet, clearly visible

cuts.shot: Medium close-up of {SABU} on the deck, golden spray glittering in the air behind her.

scenes.name: 23층
scenes.set: in a dim late-night office on the 23rd floor of a city tower, fluorescent lights, while outside the big window {SHIP} floats in the night sky above a sea of clouds
scenes.key: {MINSEOK} at his desk in the dark office, and through the window the floating ship with {SABU} at its rail.

cuts.shot: Shot from inside the dark office looking at the big window. Outside the window, {SABU} stands at the rail of the floating ship, right against the glass, completely outside the building. Nobody else is in the office except an empty desk in the foreground.
action: she taps the end of the brass spyglass twice on the outside of the window glass, tap tap, clearly visible and audible
lines: grand and solemn, slightly muffled through the glass

cuts.shot: Medium shot of {MINSEOK} alone at his desk.
action: he is hunched over his keyboard, then turns only his head toward the window, slowly, with an exhausted face

cuts.shot: Medium close-up of {SABU} at the rail of the floating ship outside the office window, seen through the glass.
action: she gives a small reassuring nod and opens her free hand, palm up

scenes.name: 동료와 함께
scenes.set: on the deck of {SHIP} sailing on a calm blue sea in the morning, where several small groups of young crew members sit together around laptops on the deck, pointing at screens and helping each other
scenes.key: {MINSEOK} leaning on the rail looking discouraged, {SABU} beside him gesturing toward groups of young people studying together around laptops on the deck behind them.

cuts.shot: Close-up of {MINSEOK} alone, leaning on the ship's rail, shoulders slumped.
action: he lets out a small tired sigh and looks down at the sea

cuts.shot: Medium shot of {SABU} standing at the rail; behind her on the deck, small groups of young people study together around laptops, clearly visible.
action: she turns and sweeps her open hand toward the groups of people studying together behind her

scenes.name: 동료
scenes.set: on the deck of {SHIP} under full cream-white sails heading into the open sea, bright sun
scenes.key: {DOHYUN} saluting {MINSEOK} on deck, {SABU} at the ship's wheel behind them.

cuts.shot: Medium two-shot of {DOHYUN} and {MINSEOK} facing each other on deck.
action: the young man snaps a crisp salute toward the office worker

cuts.shot: Medium shot of {SABU} alone at the ship's wheel, calm.

scenes.name: 엔드카드
scenes.set: at the bow of {SHIP} sailing toward a rising sun over the sea
scenes.key: Wide shot from behind of four people at the bow facing the sunrise: {SABU}, {SORA}, {DOHYUN}, {MINSEOK}.

cuts.shot: IMPORTANT: the camera is behind them and we see their backs. Wide shot from behind of exactly four people standing side by side in a row at the bow, facing the sunrise, no one else: from left to right, {SABU}, {SORA}, {DOHYUN} and {MINSEOK}. Nobody wears a black jacket. 0-2s: silence, only waves.
action: the old captain alone turns her head back over her shoulder toward the camera with a solemn, intense look
